partner_result_applied.scope_used: Product-density rearrangement p_UV(s)<=4 log(1+1/(2 sqrt|s|)) for independent densities bounded by one.

new_result.statement: For independent density<=1 X,Y,Z and invertible B=[[d,a,b],[a,0,c],[b,c,0]], Q=(X,Y,Z)^T B (X,Y,Z) has an essentially bounded density with norm <=12 exp(-2/3)|det B|^(-1/3). Arbitrary affine terms and ambient outside conditioning are allowed.
new_result.integrated_fourier_corollary: ||phi_Q||_2 <= sqrt(24 pi) exp(-1/3)|det B|^(-1/6); no L1 or pointwise decay claim.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-NEAR-PURE-CROSS-AGGREGATION-v1: obtain a dimension-free product-preserving aggregation from three large eigenvalues using diffuse, scalar-pivot, pure-cross and two-zero-diagonal branches, or extend the rearrangement argument to small/nonzero second and third diagonal entries without small-pivot loss.
next_step: Attack the near-pure-cross perturbation by retaining the two translated-product variables and treating the two added diagonal terms through a two-parameter layer-cake/rearrangement inequality; in parallel test whether fixed-row wedge mass can weight these local determinant estimates without inverse-minor divergence.
